title: Section colimit for specified unit-compatible maps
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Each stage has a precoverage $P_j$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with singleton isomorphism covers, finite indexed composition and base-change closure [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and pullbacks along covering arrows. Each covering presieve has finitely many distinct arrows. Transition functors preserve covering presieves and covering pullbacks, are continuous for the generated topologies, and their set-valued inverse images preserve finite limits. Let $V$ be a cocone whose object and arrow cocones are colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Let $Q$ be a precoverage on $V.pt$ with the same isomorphism, finite composition, finite base-change and covering-pullback axioms. A presieve belongs to $Q$ exactly when it is a transported image of a covering presieve at some stage. Each $V_j$ is continuous and preserves covering pullbacks. Fix $i\in J$, a set-valued sheaf $G$ on $P_i$, and $U\in F(i)$. Suppose $\alpha_t:F(t.hom)_sG\to V_{t.right}^sV_{i,s}G$ and $\theta_b:F(t.hom)_sG\to F(b.right)^sF(t\prime.hom)_sG$ are given for $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$ and $b:t\to t\prime$, respectively. Assume their composites with the unit at $t$ equal, in the arrow category, the unit along $V_i$ and the unit at $t\prime$, respectively, on every source-stage object. Then there exist a diagram $D:\mathrm{Under}(i)\to\mathrm{Set}$, isomorphisms $E_t:D(t)\cong (F(t.hom)_sG)(F(t.hom)U)$, a colimit cocone $K$ and $e:K.pt\cong(V_{i,s}G)(V_iU)$ such that $K_t e=E_t\alpha_t$ and $E_t\theta_b=D(b)E_{t\prime}$ as arrow-category equalities of the section maps. No finite-limit-preservation assertion is made.

proof.text: The given alpha and theta are uniquely determined by their unit equations: injectivity of each stage adjunction hom equivalence gives uniqueness. This proves coherence of the prescribed maps. The same argument gives their compatibility with refinement.

For a general limit object form the category of its stage presentations above i. The representative and eventual equality criteria give common refinements and equalizers of parallel refinements. The under category of any presentation is final. Form the filtered colimit of inverse-image sections; lift restriction arrows and use eventual equality and naturality to prove independence and the presheaf laws.

Lift a Q-cover to a finite stage cover. The assumed covering pullback preservation identifies its sheaf equalizer with the filtered colimit of stage equalizers. Commutation with finite products and equalizers proves that the constructed presheaf is a sheaf. This includes the empty-cover terminal/zero section condition.

Maps from the constructed sheaf to H correspond to compatible stage maps. Stage adjunction identifies these with a single map from G to V_i restriction of H. The reverse map uses the identity presentation and the unit. Uniqueness of adjuncts and the colimit universal property prove the two constructions inverse. The unique unit-compatible left-adjoint isomorphism identifies the construction with sheafPullback, giving alpha and the stated unit equations. The final presentation functor at V_i U gives D, E, K, e and the transition/coprojection equations. Specialize to V i U and use finality of the presentations coming from U, indexed by Under i, to obtain D, E, K and e. Uniqueness of adjuncts identifies each transition with the given theta and each coprojection with the given alpha.

theorem colimit_site_set_section_presentation
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k), PreservesFiniteLimits
      (sheafPullback (F.map a).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck)]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck (Type u))
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
                (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                  (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
                  (P t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
                  ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor (Type u)
                    (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : (∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
                  Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                    (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app
                      (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                  Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor (Type u)
                    (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X))))
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                        (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                        ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
                          (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
                          ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hθ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      (∀ X : F.obj i,
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X) ≫
                              (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X))))
    (U : F.obj i) :
    ∃ (D : Under i ⥤ (Type u))
                    (E : ∀ t : Under i, D.obj t ≅
                      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
                          (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))
                    (K : Cocone D)
                    (e : K.pt ≅ ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor (Type u)
                      (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
                        (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U))),
                    Nonempty (IsColimit K) ∧
                    (∀ t : Under i, Arrow.mk (K.ι.app t ≫ e.hom) =
                      Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫
                        (α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))) ∧
                    ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                        Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫
                          (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) =
                        Arrow.mk (D.map b ≫ (E t').hom)
